zh: 就是那个穿蓝外套的人帮我找到了钱包。
old_en: The person who wore the blue coat helped me find my wallet.
new_en: The person in the blue coat helped me find my wallet.

zh: 那个帮我搬家的同事今天请假了。
old_en: The colleague who helped me move today is on leave.
new_en: The colleague who helped me move is on leave today.

zh: 帮我搬家的那位同事今天没来。
old_en: The colleague who didn't come today helped me move.
new_en: The colleague who helped me move didn't come today.

zh: 我有一只每天都跟着我的猫。
old_en: I have a cat which follows me every day.
new_en: I have a cat that follows me every day.

zh: 我养了一只猫，它每天都跟着我。
old_en: I have a cat that follows me every day.
new_en: I have a cat that follows me every day.

zh: 这就是我们上次开会的地方。
old_en: That's where we had our last meeting.
new_en: This is where we had our last meeting.

zh: 那个总迟到的同事今天又晚了。
old_en: The colleague who is always late was late again today.
new_en: The colleague who's always late was late again today.

zh: 帮我找到钱包的是那个穿蓝外套的人。
old_en: It was the man in the blue coat who found my wallet.
new_en: The person in the blue coat helped me find my wallet.

zh: 我认识一个会修电脑的朋友。
old_en: I know a friend who can fix computers.
new_en: I know a friend who can fix computers.

zh: 我有一个朋友，他会修电脑。
old_en: I have a friend who can fix computers.
new_en: I have a friend who can fix computers.

old_en: This is the book which I bought yesterday.
new_en: This is the book I bought yesterday.

zh: 这本书是我昨天买的那本。
old_en: The book I bought yesterday is the one where you left your keys.
new_en: This is the book I bought yesterday where you left your keys.

old_en: I want to find a guide who can speak English.

old_en: I'm looking for a guide who speaks English.

old_en: That's the store which you mentioned to me.

old_en: The store you asked about is where I just bought coffee.
new_en: The store I talked about is right here.

zh: 我们上次开会的地方就是这里。
old_en: The meeting we had last time was held right where we are sitting.
new_en: This is where we had the meeting last time.

zh: 那个住在楼下的老人很热心。
old_en: The man who lives downstairs is very enthusiastic.
new_en: The old man who lives downstairs is very friendly.

zh: 住在楼下的那位老人特别热心。
old_en: The elderly man who lives downstairs is really kind and helpful.
new_en: The elderly man who lives downstairs is really kind.

zh: 总迟到的那个同事今天又迟到了。
old_en: The colleague who is always late showed up late again today.
new_en: The colleague who is always late was late again today.
